name: hyreflow
description: Source, enrich, qualify, sequence, and push candidates to your ATS from your agent. Drives the Hyreflow CLI.

interface.longDescription: Hyreflow gives your agent a full recruiting and go-to-market toolkit: search for people and companies, enrich contacts with verified work emails through a waterfall of 40+ data providers, qualify them against your criteria, run outreach sequences, and push results into your ATS or CRM. The skills drive the Hyreflow CLI; the hosted MCP server exposes the same tools to any MCP client. Sign in with your existing Hyreflow account; every spend is confirmed first.
